name: engulfing-breakout
description: Momentum strategy combining a bullish engulfing candlestick pattern with a breakout above the recent range, on above-average volume. One entry rule also carries an OPTIONAL external_signal condition referencing the trend-jack feed — in Phase 1 this is advisory-only (schema support, no live bridge), so the engine treats it as neutral and logs a warning.

entry_rules.note: Bullish engulfing pattern detected by the technicalindicators package.
Close breaks above the highest high of the previous 20 bars (resistance breakout).
Confirm with volume above its 20-bar average.

OPTIONAL / NOT YET WIRED: example of biasing entries when the trend-jack scraper reports 'crypto' trending with normalized score >= 6 (0-10 scale). Phase 1 has no signal provider, so this condition is advisory-only and evaluates as neutral. A future-phase adapter will read the trend-jack pipeline's output/trends_*.json feed.

exit_rules.note: Take momentum exits when RSI gets stretched.
